name: Gouverneur Quiet 2026

venue.name: Saint James Parochial School
venue.address: 20 S Gordon Street, Gouverneur, New York

information:
All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

This competition only has blind events. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [Gouverneur Sprint 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GouverneurSprint2026) or [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=New+York&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).
